title: Stasis Wagon of Doom
description: A macabre surreal scene shows a man in a black suit and a woman in a flowing black dress riding a red wagon labeled "Rub a Dub" pulled by two skeletons. A giant red spiky virus-like creature with glowing eyes and a toothy grin hovers beside them, emitting colorful energy streams. A heron perches atop a dilapidated green wooden building labeled "STASIS" in the background under a full moon with rings.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of a man in a black suit and a gothic woman in a long black dress riding a red wagon labeled Rub a Dub, pulled by two walking skeletons through a swampy landscape. A massive red spiky virus monster with glowing orange eyes, sharp teeth and blue nodes floats beside them emitting colorful energy ribbons. A blue heron stands on the roof of a decaying green wooden house labeled STASIS. Full moon with rings in a twilight sky, scattered red cards on the ground, ominous and macabre atmosphere.
